name: victorian-tools
description: Tooling for Victoria 2 mod files: a language server that parses Paradox script and validates it inline.

victorianTools.validation.enable.description: Enable inline validation of Victoria 2 script files.

victorianTools.validation.delay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds of typing pause before a changed file is revalidated. `0` validates on every keystroke.

victorianTools.index.rebuildDelay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after mod files change on disk before rebuilding the identifier index of the mods they belong to.

victorianTools.index.onStartup.markdownDescription: Index every mod in the workspace when the server starts, so mod-wide errors (duplicate identifiers) appear without opening a file. Turn off to index a mod only when one of its files is opened.

victorianTools.localisation.keyPattern.markdownDescription: Regular expression deciding which `title` / `desc` / `name` values are localisation keys. A value that does not match is treated as literal display text and never reported as a missing key, so `desc = "Death of Dom Pedro II"` stays silent while `desc = "EVTDESC48300"` is still checked against `localisation/`. Leave empty to check every value.

victorianTools.flags.namePattern.markdownDescription: Regular expression narrowing the never-set flag check. A country or global flag whose name does not match is never reported as checked-but-never-set, which exempts flags a mod sets outside the indexed files. Empty (the default) checks every flag.

victorianTools.nullTags.pattern.markdownDescription: Regular expression matching the tags a script uses to mean *no country*. A country value that matches is reported as a warning (`null-country-tag`) instead of an unknown-tag error, so `war = { target = --- }` and `secede_province = QQQ` stay legible. Matched case-insensitively. Leave empty to allow no exception: every unknown tag is then an error.

victorianTools.ignoreMarker.markdownDescription: A marker that silences every finding on the line it appears on. Write it as a comment (`prestige = 5 #VT - Skip Validation`) so the game ignores it. Matched anywhere in the line, case-insensitively, and it silences every rule: syntax, structure, semantics, the map CSVs and cross-file duplicates. Leave empty to turn the escape hatch off.

victorianTools.gamePath.markdownDescription: The Victoria 2 install folder (the one holding `mod/`, `common/` and `map/`). Leave empty to detect it above the workspace folder. Mods are read on top of the game files they do not `replace_path`. Set from **Settings** in the Victorian Tools side bar.

victorianTools.activeMods.markdownDescription: `name`s (from their `.mod` files) of the mods and submods being worked on, any combination. Their files are validated against the whole stack, in load order (dependencies first): game files, then each selected mod. Empty: every mod is read with its dependencies only. Set from **Settings** in the Victorian Tools side bar.

victorianTools.mapEditor.countryColorsTi.markdownDescription: Map Editor, **Country Colors** layer: how much of each province's colour comes from its owner's `color`, in percent. The rest is the province's own `definition.csv` colour, which keeps neighbours apart. `100` paints every province of a country the same; `0` shows the plain map. Set from **Settings** in the Victorian Tools side bar.

victorianTools.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the Victorian Tools language server.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
